newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Balanced Russian MinFins ease in thin Friday trade.
newsitem.headline: Balanced Russian MinFins ease in thin Friday trade.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds eased in thin trading on Friday amid uncertainty about the trend and reluctance to open new positions before the weekend, dealers said.

"The market is stuck, and it could be due to the end of short-covering in the third tranche and the unclear trend for other tranches given a similar situation in U.S. Treasuries," Most Bank dealer Alexander Rodionov said.
An International Moscow Bank dealer said market stability was due to balanced supply and demand, with banks unwilling to trade actively on Friday.
Dealers said expected little impact from results from Friday's parliamentary 1997 budget reading because the market had already priced in a likely adoption.
The State Duma lower chamber is considering the state budget in its fourth and final reading.
